summary: Require unambiguous Git branch names consistently in intent schema and runtime

delivery.outcome: Align unambiguous branch-name validation in the existing intent schema, runtime and installed bundle with Git branch rules. Reject reserved standalone @ revision shorthand and invalid dot/lock components, trailing separators/dot, leading dash and ASCII whitespace/control names while preserving valid Unicode and punctuation; publish standard 0.20.74.
nonGoals: Change branch allocation or effects/publication authority
Change physical-change, catalog or workflow-check validation
Add runtime subprocess validation or dependencies
Mutate foreign or frozen target state

architecture.decision: Use the same closed branch-name regular expression in the existing intent schema and runtime; preserve the existing bundle closure. Exercise source, bundle and schema acceptance against the actual read-only git check-ref-format --branch oracle on explicit valid/invalid names and malformed scalar input. Place regressions in the existing runtime safety suite, which is explicitly executed on both required platforms; no CI workflow expansion is needed. Explicitly reserve standalone @: Git permits refs/heads/@, but unqualified @ resolves HEAD and can differ from that literal branch. Preserve a truthful Git-oracle assertion and test this policy restriction separately with an isolated two-commit ref-resolution regression.
interfaceChanges: Existing branch-name validation rejects malformed Git names and ambiguous standalone @ revision shorthand.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material source fix through protected publication; preserve controller and review receipts.

validation.evidence: Source, bundled runtime and schema regressions reproduce incorrect acceptance and match actual Git on explicit negative/positive cases; malformed scalars remain rejected. Standalone @ is an explicit stricter policy restriction, tested separately from its accepted Git branch syntax.
Existing branch/integration/wheel/parity/native and exact-head Linux/Windows/OneDev pass.
Independent protected merge and final standard v0.20.74 release verified.
